description_en: Retrieves online features from a feature view based on one or more join IDs. For each join ID provided, the operation returns the corresponding feature fields as key-value pairs
description_zh: 根据 Join ID 查询特征视图的在线特征数据，返回每个 Join ID 对应的特征字段键值对
kebab_example: aliyun paifeaturestore list-feature-view-online-features --instance-id fs-cn-00000000 --feature-view-id 1 --join-ids user1 --config '{"dlrm_hstu":true}' --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListFeatureViewOnlineFeatures

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can get this ID by calling the `ListInstances` operation
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The feature view ID. You can get this ID by calling the `ListFeatureViews` operation
parameters.help_zh: 特征视图ID，可通过接口ListFeatureViews获取
parameters.name: feature_view_id

parameters.help_en: The join IDs used to retrieve online features
parameters.name: join_ids

v1_parameters.help_en: The feature view ID. You can get this ID by calling the `ListFeatureViews` operation
v1_parameters.help_zh: 特征视图ID，可通过接口ListFeatureViews获取
v1_parameters.name: FeatureViewId

v1_parameters.name: InstanceId
